stages.title: THREE STATE TYPES, NOT ONE HIERARCHY

pills.text: THREE STATE TYPES, NOT ONE HIERARCHY
ORIGIN CATEGORY DOES NOT PREDETERMINE CAPACITY OR WELFARE.

sequence: SUCCESSOR → Bengal, Awadh, Hyderabad: Mughal office becomes practical autonomy
AUTONOMOUS / REGIONAL → Mysore, Travancore, Rajput houses: older fields centralise selectively
NEW / MOBILISED → Marathas, Sikhs, Jats, Rohillas: armed networks and local solidarities
RULE → origin category does not predetermine capacity or welfare.

stages.title: SIKHS: COMMUNITY, MOBILISATION AND MISLS

pills.text: PERSECUTION, MOBILISATION AND ARMED COMMUNITY FORMATION
EARLY CHALLENGE; LATER REPRESSION CHANGES THE FIELD
RANJIT SINGH BELONGS ONLY AS A LATER CONSOLIDATING BRIDGE.

BANDA BAHADUR → early challenge; later repression changes the field

BOUNDARY → Ranjit Singh belongs only as a later consolidating bridge.
